input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s, so I don’t have to change it every time I send her something.
I actually can’t remember which email I used, sorry about that. But my name is Lucas Santos and my zip code is 80239. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my order.

I’m talking about order #W1588712. That’s the one I sent to my daughter in Chicago. As for her address, I’ll have to look it up since I don’t have it memorized—my memory isn’t what it used to be! But I can get it for you in a moment.

By the way, thanks for being so helpful. It’s nice to have someone to chat with, even if it’s just about orders and addresses.

Oh, I see. Maybe I got the order numbers mixed up—my mind’s a bit all over the place these days. Could you check if the other order, #W7895761, was sent to my daughter’s address in Chicago? I’m pretty sure that’s the one with the tablet.

Sorry for the confusion. I guess I’m not as sharp as I used to be. It’s just me here most days, so I really appreciate you taking the time to help me sort this out.

Thank you so much for checking all that for me. Yes, please go ahead and update my default shipping address to my daughter’s address in Chicago—943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, Chicago, IL 60621. That’ll make things a lot easier for me in the future.

And thanks for letting me know about the tablet’s storage. I was worried it might not be enough, but 64GB should be fine for her.

By the way, I hope you don’t mind me saying, but it’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just for a few minutes. Sometimes it gets a bit quiet around here. Anyway, thanks again for your help.

Yes, that’s correct. Please update my default shipping address to that Chicago address.

And thank you again for your help. It really means a lot to me to have someone walk me through all this. Sometimes I feel like I’m bothering people with all my questions, but you’ve been very patient.

That’s wonderful, thank you so much for taking care of that for me. I really appreciate your patience and kindness today. I don’t have any more questions right now, but it was nice chatting with you. Hope you have a great rest of your day! 

###STOP###
